title: Wave propagation direction
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state that the wave propagates in the negative x-direction.

title: Wave speed value
description: Essential Criteria: The response must give the correct wave speed as 1 m/s.

title: Period from vibration graph
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly identify the period (T = 4 s) from the particle's displacement-time graph.

title: Wavelength from waveform
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly identify the wavelength (λ = 4 m) from the spatial snapshot of the wave.

title: Final particle displacement
description: Essential Criteria: The response must give the correct y-coordinate (0) for the particle at x=3m and t=15s.

title: Applying wave-particle relationship
description: Important Criteria: The response must apply the relationship y(x,t) = A sin(ωt ± kx + φ) or equivalent to find the particle's displacement.

title: Sign error in phase
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response incorrectly assigns the sign in the wave function's phase (kx + ωt vs. kx - ωt) for the given propagation direction.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The response maintains consistent units (e.g., meters, seconds) throughout the calculation.
